title: Chapter 62: Four-Star Scenario!
html:
After three more failed attempts, Chen Ge gave up. He could continue experimenting once he returned to the Haunted House. To his surprise, closing Zhang Ya’s profile revealed another unread alert on the black phone.

Haven’t I finished the Bloody Heart Mission already?

Chen Ge opened the second message without much thought.

“The Specter’s Favored, congratulations for completing Rare Level Ghost, Red Specter’s Bloody Heart Mission. This mission is part of a side mission for a four-star scenario—School of the Afterlife!

“Note: When the Bloody Heart Mission’s completion rate reaches one hundred percent, it’ll unlock the Trial Mission for School of the Afterlife (Mission effective time is three months). Completing all the Trial Missions will unlock said scenario!

“School of the Afterlife—Scream Factor 4 Stars!

“Side Mission 1: Red Dancing Shoes (The school after midnight is the Red Swan’s stage. She is a wicked specter as well as a red ballet dancer). Mission Venue: Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy.

“Side Mission 2: The Hanging Man (I never kid, not in life nor in death). Mission Venue: Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy.

“Side Mission 3: The Stink (He collects all the trash in his bedroom just to hide an unspeakable secret). Mission Venue: Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy.

“Side Mission 4: The Pen Spirit Who Refused to Leave (Pen Spirit, Pen Spirit, can you tell me who will die next?) Mission Venue: Mu Yang High School.

“Side Mission 5: The Fifth Cubicle in the Toilet (Every day at midnight, people swore they could see a red shadow appear inside the toilet. To catch her, I hid inside the fifth cubicle of the toilet). Mission Venue: Mu Yang High School.

“Side Mission 6: Deep Well (One brother and one sister went to school, but how come no one returned?) Mission Venue: Mu Yang High School.

“Side Mission 7: The Sealed Classroom (There’s a classroom at the end of the corridor that’s always sealed. No one ever enters it, but every night, the classroom comes alive with activity). Mission Venue: Mu Yang High School.

“Side Mission 8: Eternal Life (In an undisclosed underground morgue, a group seeks eternal life). Mission Venue: Jiujiang Medical University.

“Last Mission: Currently Locked.”

The string of messages left Chen Ge stunned. A four-star scenario? Even a one-star scenario made forensic-science students faint. How terrifying would four stars be?

Everyone had a limit for fear, and exceeding it could harm their health. Chen Ge reread the side missions. The descriptions alone made his skin crawl, and these were merely preliminaries; the final mission remained locked. Presumably, he had to complete all eight before he could attempt it.

A four-star scenario is beyond me right now. Maybe I can challenge it someday, but certainly not yet.

Chen Ge closed the message and opened the unlockable-scenarios tab. Alongside The Third Sick Hall and The Haunted Hearse now appeared School of the Afterlife, its name written in blood-red ink.

So this scenario combines practically every haunted-school story. Even after I unlock it, I can’t simply open it to everyone.

Studying the scenarios’ Scream Factor ratings gave Chen Ge an idea. One-star scenarios could remain open to everyone, while three-star scenarios and above should admit only visitors who had survived the one- and two-star attractions. The rule would protect his customers.

It would also give the Haunted House more replay value. Visitors could return for progressively scarier challenges until they conquered every scenario. Each visit would offer something different, which would definitely increase our popularity.

He San came to mind. Technically, he was the only visitor to have challenged more than one scenario. That kid is something of a good-luck charm for the Haunted House. Maybe I should invite him back when the new scenario opens…

New ideas came quickly: rewards and certificates for surviving certain levels, incentives that would encourage visitors to attempt scarier scenarios.

I’m starting to feel like a dungeon master.

Chen Ge smiled. One day, professional teams might come to his Haunted House to discover the true meaning of fear.

“Why are you grinning like an idiot? You look as though you’re planning something awful.” Inspector Lee emerged after completing his preliminary survey. “Teams One and Two found no trace of Zhang Peng. Something about this school bothers me, and the layout is too complicated to search safely at night. We’ll withdraw and make a plan once the investigation unit arrives.”

“Okay.” Chen Ge had been ready to leave for some time. He had accomplished everything he came for.

They withdrew from the school grounds, and the police sealed the gate while awaiting reinforcements. The investigation team arrived at dawn looking every bit as exhausted as Inspector Lee’s group.

After a brief greeting, Inspector Lee drove Chen Ge home.

“Another sleepless night.” Once in the police car’s back seat, Chen Ge finally relaxed. He stretched and sank into the cushions.

“You’re the first person that I’ve come across who can be so comfortable inside a police car,” Inspector Lee commented with a degree of dissatisfaction. “By the way, I have a few questions that I haven’t had the chance to ask you until now.”

“Then don’t.” Chen Ge could already guess what was coming. He covered his face with his backpack and pretended to sleep.

“Why did you go to Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy at midnight? And how did you know the girl’s time of death? The case is four years old. Even the medical examiner would need to consult the file, yet you knew. That is not normal.” Inspector Lee climbed behind the wheel and started the engine.

“Lucky guesses.” Chen Ge turned his body about. “Uncle San Bao, can you turn the air-conditioning on?”

“You’ve dropped all formalities around me, haven’t you?” Inspector Lee grumbled as he turned on the air-conditioning. It was then that his phone suddenly rang.

“Uncle, it’s your phone.”

“Keep talking and see if I don’t throw you out.” Inspector Lee checked the caller ID before answering. Neither side spoke. Three seconds later, the call ended.

“Who’s bold enough to prank-call the police?” Chen Ge looked over and was surprised to see Inspector Lee’s expression soften.

“My wife. Whenever I’m on a special assignment, she calls to make sure I’m safe. Some operations are sensitive, so we developed our own system. I don’t have to say anything. If I answer, she knows I’m all right.”
